title: Ledger record (COMP-DOGFOOD-CUTOVER-1)
description: One row per line of smart-memory-ops coordination/ledger.md, appended to <workspace>/.compose/data/ledger-records/<day>.jsonl by lib/ledger-records.js (door: lib/ledger-records-cli.js append). The writer is smart-memory-ops claude/scripts/ledger_compose.py, called by ledger.py append and the ledger_push.py tick, at append time. A row is unique on (day, id): a replay or a union-merge move of the same line is a no-op. `stored_at` is stamped by the store; every other field comes from the writer.

id.description: owner_orders_feed.identity(date, hh:mm, by, body) over the line as written (a trailing ` [no receipt: WORD]` stripped): sha256 of the whitespace-normalized text, first 24 hex. A line not in the `- [date ]HH:MM by: body` shape (another writer's format, a continuation line) is hashed whole: identity('', '', 'raw', line).

day.description: The line's Asia/Singapore date: a dated line's own date, else the latest date whose HH:MM is not after the moment the line was written.

at.description: The line's stamp as ISO in Asia/Singapore (minute precision, the ledger's own); its date is `day`.

written_at.description: When the writer wrote the line or swept it (seconds).

by.description: The line's writer (the ledger's `<by>`). For a line in another shape, its loose writer token with refused characters made `_`, or `unknown` when it has none.

text.description: The line's body as written, with no stamp or writer.

line.description: The whole ledger line as written, without its newline.

source.description: `ledger.py` (its own append), `swept` (a line another writer appended, committed by ledger.py's commit), `timer` (committed by the ledger_push tick).

replayed.description: Sent from the backlog after an earlier send failed.
